connector.name: Tweetkit X
connector.registryDescription: Post, delete & read on X (Twitter) using your own logged-in web session - no paid API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package tweetkit-x. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nsozturk account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: TWEETKIT_COOKIE_KEYCHAIN
env.description: macOS Keychain service name holding your X session cookie string (must contain auth_token + ct0). Alternatively set TWEETKIT_COOKIE (the raw cookie string) or TWEETKIT_COOKIE_FILE (a file path).

env.name: TWEETKIT_COOKIE
env.description: Your X (Twitter) session cookie string — the Cookie header from a logged-in x.com request. Must contain auth_token and ct0.
